subject.summary: Personal financial advisors (O*NET 13-2052.00) learn about a client's assets, liabilities, cash flow, protection, tax situation, and goals, explain available budgeting, investment, insurance, and retirement planning options, and record assumptions, fees, risks, conflicts of interest, and follow-up reviews.
